text:
Aisha: Hi team — just started last week and my digital insurance card says active but the clinic says the subscriber ID isn't recognized. They said enrollment might not have propagated. Surgery scheduled 2026-05-04, worried about preauth/claims. Any quick fixes?
Priya (People Ops): Welcome Aisha! Likely an enrollment propagation lag. Two quick steps: 1) DM me your start date + last 4 of SSN; 2) have the clinic hold any billing until we confirm. I can push an expedited roster update to the carrier.
Aisha: Start date 2026-04-28, last4 7789. Clinic is asking for proof of coverage today.
Liam (Benefits): We can generate an eligibility verification letter that clinics accept for preauths while carrier syncs. Priya, can you request an expedited sync?
onboarding-bot: New hire checklist: enrollment submitted 2026-04-28, carrier feed status: pending (2 business days typical). See https://benefits.redwood.com/enrollments.
Priya (People Ops): Pushed manual roster update to carrier and asked for 24-48hr expedite. Liam — please generate eligibility letter with subscriber ID ending in 7789 and coverage effective 2026-04-28. Aisha — bring the eligibility PDF to the clinic or email it to their billing.
Liam (Benefits): Generated eligibility PDF and uploaded to the clinic portal (ref #CL-5521). Also emailed billing with note to hold claims until enrollment confirmed.
Aisha: Thanks! Clinic accepted the eligibility letter and put preauth in. Appreciate the fast help.
Priya (People Ops): Tagging this for follow-up. If you get any EOB denials after the date of service, forward to benefits@redwood.com with subject "New hire enrollment - Aisha" and we'll escalate.
Aisha: Will do. Thanks everyone :pray:
